bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
WT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.worktrees/search-colors-5a93de6"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = 5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if docker build --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6 "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
python3 - "$LOG" <<'PY'
import pathlib,re,sys
s=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors="replace")
patterns=[
(101,r'RUN corepack enable|corepack prepare pnpm'),
(102,r'RUN pnpm install|pnpm install --frozen'),
(103,r'RUN pnpm --dir artifacts/bot run build:gaybbs'),
(104,r'RUN node --check'),
(105,r'RUN npm install --omit=dev'),
(106,r'COPY .*from=build'),
(107,r'COPY \. \.'),
(108,r'FROM .*node|load metadata for'),
]
m=re.findall(r'ERROR:.*|failed to solve:.*',s,re.I)
tail="\n".join(m[-5:]) if m else s[-1200:]
for code,pattern in patterns:
 if re.search(pattern,tail,re.I):sys.exit(code)
# Prefer explicit failure step reference from buildkit output
steps=re.findall(r'^#[0-9]+ \[([^]]+)\].*ERROR',s,re.I|re.M)
if steps:
 step=steps[-1].lower()
 for code,pattern in patterns:
  if re.search(pattern,step,re.I):sys.exit(code)
sys.exit(109)
PY
